---
title: "Nairaland rationales comparison plot"
author: Casey Breen
---

Summary: Create dumbbell figure comparing the rationales posters give for
low-fertility ideals (0-3 children) vs high-fertility ideals (5+ children)
on Nairaland, 2010-2018. Rationale codes come from LLM coder passes under a
fixed codebook; shares are among posts in each group that give any rationale.

```{r}
## Library packages
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
```

## load rationale codes

```{r}
## one row per ideal post with its rationale codes, assembled by
## code/scraping/5_build_coding_batches.R from the LLM coding outputs
rat <- read_csv(here("data", "nairaland", "coded_output", "rationales_coded.csv"))
```

## create plot

```{r}
## posts that give any rationale, split by stated ideal (4 excluded as neither)
groups <- rat %>%
  filter(!is.na(rationales), rationales != "", ideal_n != 4) %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(ideal_n <= 3, "Low ideal (0-3)", "High ideal (5+)"))
n_low  <- sum(groups$group == "Low ideal (0-3)")
n_high <- sum(groups$group == "High ideal (5+)")

cats <- c(economic_cost = "Economic cost / affordability",
          child_quality = "Child quality / education",
          career_aspiration = "Career / personal goals",
          womens_autonomy = "Women's autonomy / health",
          family_planning = "Family planning practicalities",
          modern_western = "Modern / Western comparison",
          religion_blessing = "Religion / divine blessing",
          lineage_continuity = "Lineage / family continuity",
          security_status = "Children as security / status",
          traditional_norm = "Tradition / custom")

## share of each group's posts giving each rationale, sorted by low-ideal share
shares <- map_dfr(names(cats), function(cc) {
  groups %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(share = mean(str_detect(rationales, cc)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cat = cats[[cc]])
}) %>%
  mutate(cat = fct_reorder(cat, share * (group == "Low ideal (0-3)"), sum))

nairaland_rationales_comparison_plot <- ggplot(shares, aes(x = 100 * share, y = cat)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = cat), colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = group), size = 3.4, stroke = 1.1, shape = 21,
             colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low ideal (0-3)" = "darkblue",
                               "High ideal (5+)" = "darkorange"),
                    breaks = c("Low ideal (0-3)", "High ideal (5+)")) +
  labs(x = "Share of posts giving this rationale (%)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

## Save plot
ggsave(plot = nairaland_rationales_comparison_plot,
       filename = here("figures", "nairaland_rationales_comparison_plot.png"),
       height = 5.5, width = 7.3, bg = "white", dpi = 300)
```
